title: Trust and Financial Reporting Quality

scopes.description: Produce all 13 Internet Appendix tables supplied in the document. The appendix reports supplementary regression results and variable definitions, but the package provides no executable workflow, analysis files, or complete input lineage.

requirements.description: Author-provided analysis data and any upstream inputs needed to reproduce all 13 Internet Appendix tables are required; the document describes supplementary regression analyses, including first-stage 2SLS models, but does not supply compatible input files, complete field/identifier/coverage specifications, or a build workflow.

issues.description: The assigned package contains only an online appendix PDF with reported results and variable definitions. No runnable author code, entry point, run instructions, or producer map is supplied; the actual workflow and full dependency closure remain unknown.

evidence.description: The supplied appendix begins with first-stage 2SLS regression results and associated constructs.
evidence.quote: This table presents the results of the first stage from 2SLS regressions investigating the association between TRUST and measures of financial reporting quality, including ACCRUAL-QUALITY, MISSTATEMENT, and ICMW.

evidence.description: The supplied online appendix includes a thirteenth table of additional regression results.
evidence.quote: Internet Appendix Table 13: OLS Regression of Absolute Abnormal Accruals on Trust

evidence.description: Bounded package inventory lists only the appendix PDF, and the static code-coverage report has status no_supported_code.

actions.description: Request the author workflow and compatible data materials needed to regenerate all 13 Internet Appendix tables; do not infer or independently reconstruct historical inputs from the variable definitions.
steps: Obtain the author-provided executable workflow or an explicitly approved alternative, including entry points, required stage order, and software/runtime requirements for every supplied appendix table.

Obtain compatible author-prepared analysis data or a complete input inventory and documented acquisition/build instructions that identify files, fields, identifiers, periods, formats, and generated intermediates.
Ask the author to identify any survey, analysis, or other supporting files and programs required to construct the inputs used in the 13 tables.
validation: After receipt, verify that every supplied appendix table has a documented producer and that each required input has specified fields and compatible coverage.
Run the complete supplied workflow and compare generated tables with the appendix only under a separately authorized execution step.

review_notes: No analysis_only scope is supported because the assigned package contains neither runnable analysis code nor author-prepared analysis data.
